title: Morning Brief
summary: The founders agreed to keep the course focused on operator decision-making, with detailed prompt and creative-strategy material added over time from student feedback, and to build competitive research into the company SaaS as its retention engine. For Black Friday they will keep one-time purchase optional and test a lower $29 entry price, judged on conversion and revenue per visitor. Brand pages are nearly ready once the cacao product reference is fixed, and video-editor hiring is the main bottleneck, with Avia possibly needing about 10 more editors.
points: Course scope: marketing basics, infrastructure, AI tools, tracking and one-on-one decision support
Competitive-discovery tool as the base of the SaaS: repeat runs, ad-library data, creative dashboards, possible AI briefs
Adding 4Play and Get Hooked as data sources and reducing reliance on outside tools
Brand pages connected to the checkout channel; Clinician's Choice page shows Maya ceremonial cacao by mistake
Subscription data: about 80% subscribe and 20% one-time purchase
Pricing comparison: Hascap at 39/59/79 against Clarity MD at 29/59/89
Walmart and Target marketplace setup in progress
Senior video-editor role to train and quality-check other editors; developer to speed up SaaS, course and onboarding work
decisions: Keep the course operator-first; detailed creative strategy is bonus material that grows with members
Make the company SaaS the home for competitive research and recurring reports
Keep one-time purchase available alongside subscription
Test a $29 entry price for Black Friday, measured on conversion and revenue per visitor
Start ads once the cacao reference on the brand page is corrected
Youssef takes the senior video-editor candidate call today

tasksImported.title: Finalise the course details, including the Ad Creators Lab section
Record the additional course videos over the weekend
Set up Walmart and Target marketplace presence
Correct the Maya ceremonial cacao reference on the Clinician's Choice page
Bring Cassandra in to source and train video editors
Send the developer call link to Youssef

Add 4Play and Get Hooked as data sources to the competitive-research tool
Run the senior video editor candidate call
Test a $29 entry price for Black Friday and track conversion and revenue per visitor
